name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3414: REG-1141. Found by measuring the leading dash in the GrokBot native visual passes. _heartChipPaint had two branches painting IDENTICAL pixels: a census nobody took set textContent to heart and removed data-dark, and a TAKEN, clean census set the SAME text and removed the SAME attribute. Only el.title differed, and a title needs a hover, so a heart that had never been measured read exactly like a healthy one on his status bar. The feed was worse than the painter: the deferred first read swallowed its own catch, and the overlay printed THE CONSOLE DID NOT ANSWER while the chip two centimetres away kept the last clean face. The untaken state now has its own word, attribute and colour, the chip boots wearing it, and BOTH failure arms repaint through _heartChipPaint(null). The gate DRIVES the shipped painter in node against a stub element, so the verdict is read off the element and never off the title: 14 cases, 5 RED_PROOFs all PROVEN. Heart row the chip can say nobody looked republishes the reason heart_state gives when the census refuses, so when the chip does read not taken his console says which link broke.
